_comment: Single source of truth for what /draft reads from GET /api/data. Cited by frontend/app/draft/page.jsx (fetch comments) and enforced by tests/api/test_draft_contract_view_fields.py. Add a path here when /draft starts reading a new contract field; the test then proves each served view still carries it.

sleeperTeamsFetches._comment: Mount fetch + roster-gap fetch in app/draft/page.jsx. Read only the Sleeper team map and its readiness/league stamps (draftTeamsFromContract). Served as view=compact (same URL as the sync fetch; view=app is NOT used because it is not smaller than compact and strips playersArray).

rookieSyncFetch._comment: Manual 'Sync rookies' fetch. Needs playersArray rows (view=app strips playersArray and its legacy players dict lacks rookie/assetClass/position/displayName). Served as view=compact.
